criteria.requirement: Add ConfigObj.write_atomic(filename=None), preserving ordinary write/outfile behavior. Serialize a raw-preserving clone through the real ConfigObj writer before opening any temporary file; use a unique same-directory temporary, preserve existing permission bits or use 0600 for a new file, close before os.replace and clean only the operation temp on failure. Default to self.filename, support PathLike, reject missing destination and symlink targets, return the absolute destination. Serialization/encoding/replace errors must preserve old bytes and original in-memory metadata. Do not promise power-loss durability or cross-file atomicity.
必须交付授权源码、能在原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；所有冻结原生回归通过。

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
